$ mail-find search label:inbox
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
mail-find: error: "label:inbox" is not in the portable grammar:
from:ADDR|DOMAIN  to:ADDR|DOMAIN  subject:WORD|"PHRASE"  has:attachment
after:YYYY/MM/DD  before:YYYY/MM/DD  newer_than:Nd  older_than:Nd  "exact phrase"  word
Use --native to pass provider syntax through untouched
